{{Top|notoc=1}}
'''Bekk Tunit''' was a [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] famous<ref name="InsidetheWorlds">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to 32 BBY. ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'' depicts Bekk Tunit's glove at [[Wald's Parts|Watto's shop]] during the events of the film.</ref> At some point by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the racer had crashed and left behind a [[Glove/Legends|glove]] at the crash site.<ref name="InsidetheWorlds" /> During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="InsidetheWorlds" /> in 32 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] had possession of it and kept it at his [[Wald's Parts|junk shop]], located in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The glove was displayed on his treasured trophy shelf of podracer memorabilia in his nest.<ref name="InsidetheWorlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bekk Tunit was first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', a [[2000]] reference book authored by [[Kristin Lund|Kristen Lund]].<ref name="InsidetheWorlds" />
